adjudication_history.source_quote: Mild thinning of the medial compartment articular cartilage is noted.
adjudication_history.rationale: Retain preread: mild actual cartilage thinning and minor degeneration do not explicitly specify superficial-only loss or thickness fraction. The reader interprets mild as below threshold; the reviewer preserves missing depth and region evidence. Mild-thinning operational interpretation remains flagged for global QA.

adjudication_history.source_quote:
Difuzno je povišen intenzitet signala intrasupstancijski u medijalnom i lateralnom menisku
prvenstveno uslijed degenerativnih promjena, bez jasnih znakova rupture uz ekstruziju
medijalnog meniska.
adjudication_history.rationale: Withdraw preread negative: explicitly internal degenerative signal is accompanied by medial extrusion, so the isolated-internal-degeneration exclusion does not fully characterize this meniscus. No clear rupture and unquantified extrusion do not establish qualifying abnormal morphology either; final masked. Lateral internal degeneration without extrusion remains negative.

adjudication_history.source_quote: No hay alteraciones en significativas de la médula ósea.
adjudication_history.rationale: Withdraw preread negative after rereading the acute-trauma report: no significant marrow alteration is qualified absence and leaves low-grade impact edema unresolved. The acute indication does not itself diagnose contusion. The preread interpretation of conventional normality is preserved, but this exact statement is not unqualified normal marrow.

adjudication_history.source_quote: No localized bone edema is seen.
adjudication_history.rationale: Retain preread: no LOCALIZED bone edema excludes one distribution but does not explicitly exclude all marrow edema. Partial cruciate injuries do not resolve marrow scope, and no bony destruction is not an impact-edema assessment. Reader negative remains a documented scope disagreement.

Withdraw preread negative: no skeletal abnormality OF NOTE is a qualified significance judgment without an explicit marrow-normal or no-contusion statement. It does not reliably exclude a smaller impact lesion. Original conventional-normality interpretation remains recorded.

Withdraw preread negative: the same qualified skeletal statement lacks explicit normal cortex or absent fracture line and may omit a small finding judged not noteworthy. Final uncertainty preserves that scope without inferring fracture from silence.

adjudication_history.source_quote: No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
adjudication_history.rationale: Withdraw preread negative: no significant marrow signal change is qualified rather than explicit normal signal. The separate no secondary bony changes refers to cartilage ulcers and does not independently assess all impact marrow changes. Original broad-normality interpretation is preserved.

adjudication_history.source_quote: Medialseitig etwas ausgedeünnter Knorpel femoral (Outerbrdige II).
adjudication_history.rationale: Retain preread: named Outerbridge II plus somewhat thinned cartilage does not explicitly establish a thickness fraction or superficial-only lesion. Outerbridge terminology must not be substituted for the separately defined ICRS depth scale. Reader mild-thinning negative remains a source-specific grading disagreement.

adjudication_history.source_quote: Scattered foci of mild chondrosis throughout the patellofemoral compartment.
adjudication_history.rationale: Retain preread: scattered mild chondrosis is a severity description without explicit preserved thickness, superficial-only defects or a depth fraction. The reader treats mild as below threshold; this extraction keeps missing cartilage-depth evidence masked.

adjudication_history.source_quote: Scattered foci of mild chondrosis throughout the patellofemoral compartment.
adjudication_history.rationale: Retain preread: mild/subtle chondrosis does not directly describe thickness preserved or depth of focal defects. The lateral mild-to-moderate finding does not supply PF depth. Reader negative and reviewer uncertainty are preserved for consistency QA.

adjudication_history.source_quote: Focal increased T2SI at cartilage of mid lateral patella facet, measured about intact7xintact2xintact4 cm in axial and vertical diameters, suggested mild cartilaginous injury. No adjacent subchondral lesion is seen.
adjudication_history.rationale: Retain preread: focal T2 signal increase and suggested mild cartilage injury do not document actual maintained cartilage depth or superficial-only loss. Corrupted intact-number dimensions cannot be repaired into extent evidence. Reader mild-injury negative is preserved as unresolved.

adjudication_history.source_quote: Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Partial thickness fissuring along the lateral patellar facet. The trochlear cartilage is intact.
adjudication_history.rationale: Retain preread: partial-thickness fissuring may exceed 50% depth; the mild-chondrosis impression does not quantify it. The same impression includes medial full-thickness fissuring, demonstrating that mild global impression is not a reliable depth bound here. Region size also absent.

adjudication_history.source_quote: Moderate joint effusion with mild synovial proliferation.
adjudication_history.rationale: Retain preread: mild synovial proliferation establishes lining change but not explicitly inflammation or diagnosed synovitis. Effusion out of proportion and conditional consideration of sampling for inflammatory disease or infection do not confirm those possibilities. Reader positive is retained as a semantic disagreement.

review_flags.issue: Reader mild cartilage thinning/chondrosis/injury negatives remain uncertain after review: depth and qualifying extent are not explicit. Source49 mild impression includes medial full-depth fissuring; no automatic mild=depth rule adopted.
Extrusion with internal degeneration and uncomplicated discoid variants remain unresolved against abnormal-morphology criterion; no blanket variant or extrusion mapping.
Qualified marrow/skeletal absence masked after rereading; source20 selective no-localized-edema scope remains a reader-reviewer disagreement. Original preread interpretations preserved.
Synovial proliferation without direct inflammatory diagnosis remains uncertain; reader positive preserved.
Greek moderate fluid with literal subarticular wording interpreted as joint effusion by both passes in local context, retained as localization QA flag.
Fracture acuity, probable trabecular impaction and separate impact edema retain source-specific masks; acute ligament context does not silently settle fracture timing.
Unfilled grades/measurements and contradictions remain unrepaired; source16 bone-bruise versus no-contusion conflict remains masked.
Preread exact quote expansions include the full separately described marrow compartments used for global negative. States were unchanged and expansion log preserved outside initiative.

reader_flags_considered.issue: Unfilled NC/NA grades/sequences, malformed intact-number measurements and isolated0 fields preserved without parsing or repair.
Very sparse reports: Hoffa-only013 has all12 targets unmentioned; medial-meniscal-tear-only032 has just that target positive. Silence never filled negative.
Source conflicts: direct small partial medial tear versus nonsurfacing grade2a description; direct bone bruise versus no bone contusion. Conflicting targets remain masked.
Uncomplicated/normal-variant discoid meniscus versus rubric abnormal morphology is unresolved for021/027. Case044 has definite bucket-handle tear and is positive independently of congenital shape.

Meniscal morphology/anatomy: degeneration plus extrusion ambiguous006; inner/outer names swapped between headings025 but both explicitly intact; lateral marginal amputation041 supports abnormal morphology. No silent anatomy repair.

Moderate fluid uses literal subarticular wording in a joint/suprapatellar context; effusion interpretation flagged. Synovial fatty metaplasia/possible early lipoma arborescens does not establish inflamed thickened lining.
Partial or absent assessment of whole cartilage/marrow compartments and anterior heading that only describes patellar height are not filled from silence. Review explicit scope and masked values.
Cartilage severity/depth versus extent, low-grade descriptions, qualified negative statements, and focal high-grade lesions require source-specific review; no automatic OA/numbered-grade positives.
Fracture acuity, probable traumatic trabecular impaction and impact-related marrow interpretation remain source-specific. No blanket subtype mapping or automatic transfer from earlier bone audits.
Dutch laterale banden ambiguity for MCL; both remain masked rather than assume plural lateral structures mean all collaterals.
Moderate suprapatellar distension conflicts with minimal hydrops conclusion, effusion masked; directly diagnosed chronic synovitis remains positive.
Incompletely graded OA, generic ACL tear fraction, nonspecific bone changes and garbled anatomy preserved; original wording is not automatically corrected.
Baker dimensions without adopted clinical severity category remain masked; small/moderate range in effusion likewise crosses threshold.
Nondiagnostic refers only to scout localizers, not the complete diagnostic examination. No report exclusion or automatic quality downgrade.

primary_references_considered.title: ICRS Cartilage Injury Evaluation Package

primary_references_considered.verified_fact: ICRS Grade 2 describes lesions reaching less than50% of cartilage depth.
primary_references_considered.use: Below-threshold depth only for the report that explicitly names ICRS; not transferred to unkeyed gradeII reports.

notes: All 50 original blinded reports independently read and all 600 decisions frozen before opening reader draft or flags. Every target compared, all 50 reader notes and flags read, all 11 differing sources reread. Thirteen initial disagreements explicitly adjudicated: five changes from preread and eight changes from draft. Original draft/preread preserved. Exact quotes, schema, UID coverage and artifact hashes validated. No gold, legacy labels, automatic inference or default filling. Outstanding interpretation questions remain visibly masked/flagged for global semantic QA; completion of this extraction review does not certify image diagnostic accuracy.
